decks.notes: The key concept of this Aggro-Affinity deck is to quickly and aggressively drop artifact creatures and other artifacts on the battlefield to overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch, Mishra's Bauble, Mox Opal, and Urza's Saga, the deck aims to generate fast mana and card advantage. The deck also includes disruption tools like Metallic Rebuke and Pithing Needle to control the opponent's game plan. With a focus on efficient artifact synergies and a high tempo playstyle, the deck aims to quickly close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's game plan while applying pressure with aggressive creatures. It utilizes cards like Thoughtseize and Prismatic Ending to disrupt the opponent's hand and board state, while also using cards like Ephemerate to blink creatures for additional value. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Solitude, while also using powerful creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and Ketramose, the New Dawn to close out the game quickly. Additionally, the deck includes graveyard hate with Relic of Progenitus to disrupt any graveyard strategies from the opponent.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, supported by burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Dismember. It also utilizes cards like Ranger-Captain of Eos for tutoring, Goblin Bombardment for reach, and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah for additional creature support. The deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain control of the board with cards like Static Prison and Voice of Victory, while utilizing efficient removal options like Thraben Charm and Ocelot Pride to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble an explosive combo using cards such as Thundertrap Trainer, Hydroelectric Specimen, and Goblin Charbelcher to deal massive damage to the opponent. It focuses on using disruptive spells like Suppression Ray and Sink into Stupor to control the board while being able to search for key combo pieces with Whir of Invention. The deck aims to win quickly and efficiently without relying on traditional land cards, making it a unique and powerful combo strategy in Modern 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay by using a mix of powerful creatures and versatile spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing a combination of low-cost creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Territorial Kavu, along with powerful spells like Tribal Flames and Lightning Bolt, this deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The inclusion of Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding helps to control the board and protect key creatures, while cards like Stubborn Denial provide added disruption to opponent's strategies. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive playstyle and ensure consistency in casting spells.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and aggressive creatures like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah, Ocelot Pride, and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury. Combined with cards like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment for removal and token generation, this deck aims to apply constant pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Arena of Glory and Elegant Parlor provides additional support and utility. Overall, this deck focuses on quick, efficient creature attacks and removal spells to quickly take down the opponent's life total.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful Eldrazi creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent and deal a large amount of damage in a short amount of time. By using cards like Chalice of the Void to disrupt the opponent's game plan and Kozilek's Command to control the board, the goal is to establish a dominant presence on the battlefield early on. With a mix of aggressive creatures and mana acceleration, this deck aims to apply pressure and force the opponent to react quickly or risk being overrun by the Eldrazi horde.

The deck focuses on aggressively deploying Eldrazi creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent. Cards like Thought-Knot Seer and Sowing Mycospawn disrupt the opponent's strategy while creatures like Glaring Fleshraker and Sire of Seven Deaths deal massive damage. Chalice of the Void and Kozilek's Command provide additional disruption, making it difficult for the opponent to respond effectively. The mana base is optimized for casting Eldrazi creatures efficiently, with Eldrazi Temple and Cavern of Souls helping to accelerate the deck's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain board control to secure a quick victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and burn spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The key strategy is to establish a strong board presence early with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer, while utilizing burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to clear the way for attacks. The deck also includes cards like Static Prison and Thraben Charm to control the opponent's board, allowing for continuous pressure. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provides a strong finisher, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker helps to refill the hand and maintain momentum.

The key concept of this UR Aggro deck is to aggressively control the board and apply pressure to the opponent through efficient creatures and burn spells. The deck focuses on using cheap spells and creatures like Monastery Swiftspear, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Lightning Bolt to deal damage quickly. Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration provide card advantage and help maintain tempo. The deck also includes land-fetching cards like Wooded Foothills and Arid Mesa to ensure consistent mana sources for its spells. Overall, the strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with swift and precise aggression.

The deck focuses on using ramp spells and mana acceleration to quickly cast powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. It also utilizes control elements like Kozilek's Return and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Ancient Stirrings and Talisman of Impulse help with consistency and finding key pieces. The overall strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with large threats and control the game until victory is achieved. The key concept is to ramp into powerful Eldrazi creatures while controlling the board.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize the Amulet of Vigor and Primeval Titan combo to quickly ramp up mana and search for key lands such as Gruul Turf and Vesuva. By using cards like Scapeshift and Green Sun's Zenith, the deck aims to search for specific pieces to create an overwhelming board presence and overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures and lands. The deck also includes unique lands like Lotus Field and Boseiju, Who Endures to provide additional support and flexibility in executing its game plan.

The key concept of this UR Aggro deck is to maintain a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler to apply pressure early in the game. By combining efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt with pump spells like Mutagenic Growth, the deck can quickly build a threatening board presence while disrupting opponents' game plans. Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration provide card advantage and help smooth out draws, allowing the deck to consistently apply pressure and close out the game before opponents have a chance to stabilize.

The main concept of the deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive Boros Aggro strategy. The deck focuses on putting pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, while also utilizing burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to finish off the opponent. Additionally, cards like Arena of Glory and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provide support and buffs to the creatures, while Static Prison and Thraben Charm help control the board. Overall, the deck aims to win the game quickly through a combination of creature aggression and burn damage.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures and control the game with various removal spells and board wipes. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with huge threats like Emrakul, the Promised End, while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Return. By using cards like Utopia Sprawl and Talisman of Impulse, the deck can accelerate its mana production to cast its high-cost Eldrazi spells earlier than the opponent can handle. The Eldrazi creatures also provide additional value and disruption, making it difficult for the opponent to establish any sort of board presence.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble a powerful combo without relying on traditional land cards. Instead, it focuses on utilizing various cards and abilities such as Whir of Invention and Lotus Bloom to quickly set up game-winning plays. The deck also includes a mix of control elements like Suppression Ray and Spell Snare to protect its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By utilizing cards like Tameshi, Reality Architect and Thundertrap Trainer, the deck aims to outmaneuver the opponent and secure victory through efficient and impactful plays.
